نختلب (form VIII)
# نَخْتَلِبُ (naḵtalibu) /nax.ta.li.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# نُخْتَلَبُ (nuḵtalabu) /nux.ta.la.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# نَخْتَلِبَ (naḵtaliba) /nax.ta.li.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# نُخْتَلَبَ (nuḵtalaba) /nux.ta.la.ba/:
